verdict.rationale: Runpod is a GPU cloud platform with automation surfaces (REST/GraphQL APIs, CLI, MCP servers, agent skills, templates), so versioning and rolling back deployments or automations is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence documents versioning, review, change history, or rollback for templates, endpoints, or automations. Templates and APIs only enable automation; they are not version control or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
